errors.text_span: when evaluated under three distinct input conditions: Audio (represented by solid blue bars), Noise (represented by solid purple bars), and Random Choice (represented by a dashed light blue line)
errors.evidence: The chart shows two input conditions, "Audio" and "Noise". "Random Choice" is a reference baseline, not a third input condition.

errors.text_span: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieves approximately 30% accuracy for both Audio and Noise
errors.evidence: The bar for "Noise" under Qwen2-Audio-Instruct is clearly lower than the "Audio" bar and the 30% line. Its value is approximately 23%, not 30%.

errors.text_span: Audio-Reasoner achieves approximately 38% for Audio and 30% for Noise
errors.evidence: This sentence contains two inaccuracies. The value for "Audio" is closer to 37%, making 38% a slight overestimation. More importantly, the value for "Noise" is visibly above the 30% baseline (at approx. 31%), so stating it is 30% is incorrect.
The bar for Audio under Qwen-2.5-Omni is closer to 57%. 58% is a slight overestimation.
